title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
summary: Return the kth largest value in an unsorted array without fully sorting it.

tests.explain: Sorted from largest: 9, 7, 5, 3, 1. The 2nd one is 7.
Duplicates count separately: from largest the values are 4, 4, 4, 3, 2, 1, so the 3rd largest is still 4.
A single value is its own 1st largest.

hints: Sorting and reading index k - 1 works in O(n log n). Can you avoid ordering values you will never look at?
Walk the array keeping only the k largest values seen so far in a min-heap: push each value, and pop whenever the heap grows past k.
After the walk the heap holds the k largest values, and its top (the smallest of them) is the answer. That is O(n log k).

complexity.time: O(n log k): each of the n values costs at most one push and one pop on a heap of size k
